title: GarGraves tab: a Gauge on the 132 rows that had none (Master Version 2.82)
rule: A row gets the gauge GarGraves itself gives it: its own product line names the gauge, or the section heading it sits under does ("Z-Stuff for Trains - O Gauge Accessories", "Grade Crossing Kits — O or S gauge", "Acme Switch Controllers for All Gauges"). Hardware, wire, bulbs, tools and switch machines for which GarGraves names no gauge fit every gauge it sells and get "All Gauges" — the app (gargauge) reads that on this tab as all six scales GarGraves sells. Only column I changes; only cells that were blank.
stated: Brad 2026-11-06 13:19 CT "The GarGraves catalog has two data gaps … 132 rows have no Gauge … 3 rows use two-gauge spellings the app doesn't read. fix this" → 13:22 CT "yes" to the plan (GARGRAVES_GAUGE_PLAN_2026-11-06.xlsx) → 15:10 CT "Yes" to writing the 132 gauges (record, write, read-back, Master Version 2.82, audit)
